propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui beatum Petrum Confessorem tuum admirabilis paenitentiae et
altissimae contemplationis munere illustrare dignatus es: da nobis,
quaesumus; ut, ejus suffragantibus meritis, carne mortificati, facilius
caelestia capiamus. Per Dominum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

translations.source_label: The New Roman Missal in Latin and English, revised edition, by F. X. Lasance and Francis Augustine Walsh (New York: Benziger Brothers, 1945), ca. 1955-56 printing (Internet Archive delivery locator fr-lasance-missal-1937; locator mislabelled)
translations.text: O God, Who didst vouchsafe to make blessed Peter, Thy confessor, glorious by the gift of a wonderful spirit of penance and most lofty contemplation, grant us, we beseech Thee, that, through his interceding merits, being mortified in the flesh, we may the more easily understand the things of heaven. Through our Lord.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Quaesumus, omnipotens Deus: ut, qui caelestia alimenta percepimus,
intercedente beato Petro Confessore tuo, per haec contra omnia adversa
muniamur. Per Dominum.
